components.css: .ds-pass { --stub: 180px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr var(--stub); min-width: 460px; border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; background: radial-gradient(110% 90% at 100% 0%, oklch(0.9 0.19 128 / 0.24), transparent 58%), repeating-linear-gradient(118deg, transparent 0 13px, oklch(0.98 0.012 140 / 0.05) 13px 14px), oklch(0.33 0.075 160); color: oklch(0.98 0.012 140); font: 500 14px/1.4 'Mona Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle 12px at calc(100% - var(--stub)) 0, #0000 98%, #000) top / 100% 51% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle 12px at calc(100% - var(--stub)) 100%, #0000 98%, #000) bottom / 100% 51% no-repeat; mask: radial-gradient(circle 12px at calc(100% - var(--stub)) 0, #0000 98%, #000) top / 100% 51% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle 12px at calc(100% - var(--stub)) 100%, #0000 98%, #000) bottom / 100% 51% no-repeat; } .ds-pass-body, .ds-pass-stub { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 24px; } .ds-pass-body strong { font-size: 52px; font-weight: 780; font-stretch: 112%; letter-spacing: -0.035em; line-height: 0.95; } .ds-pass-stub { border-inline-start: 2px dashed oklch(0.98 0.012 140 / 0.3); } .ds-pass-cap { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 660; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.84 0.05 150); }

narrative.overview: What a student carries is a pass. The next class, a reward voucher and the points balance are drawn as tickets with a tear-off stub, on a bright ground of soft white cards. The system is consumer-grade and energetic rather than administrative: colour does real jobs at page scale, controls are pills, and motion is short and purposeful.
keyCharacteristics: At most one pine field per screen; orange is reserved for points.
White cards with a 20px radius and a soft green-tinted shadow.
Pill controls; lime only on pine or as the assistant's mark.
Light and dark themes; English and Arabic with right-to-left mirroring.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: A screen has at most one pine field. If two things compete for it, one of them is a card.

rules.name: The Lime Is A Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime never fills a large area in light mode. It marks the action on a pass, the current stop, and the assistant.

rules.name: The Colour Has A Job Rule
rules.body: Blue, orange and orchid name modules; green, yellow and red name states. None is decoration.

rules.name: The Caption Stays On The Pass Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked captions appear only as field names printed on a pass.

dos: Do give each screen one thing to carry and draw it as a pass or a pine field.
Do keep controls as pills, cards at 20px and fields at 12px.
Do lead list rows with an icon tile in the row's module or state colour.
Do label anything simulated or stored on the device.
donts: Don't bring back the dark side rail, ink buttons or flat hairline-ruled sheets of the rejected first rebuild.
Don't use lime as a large fill in light mode, or white text on lime or orange.
Don't put an uppercase label above a heading.
Don't let the assistant submit, reserve or spend without a confirmation card.
